hero.description: I approach every project with a mix of pragmatism and curiosity. I apply the solutions I know and dive into learning the ones I don't. The goal is simple: to write the best code for the specific problem, ensuring I'm never a blocker to growth, but an accelerator.

intro.paragraph: I'm a passionate Software Developer with expertise in React, Next.js, & modern web technologies. I specialize in building user-friendly applications that solve real-world problems.
